verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Stripe serves an llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) containing agent-directed instructions. Radar docs are also available as clean markdown (radar.md returned HTTP 200, and all cited Radar doc pages are .md URLs), so an agent can be pointed straight at them. Missing for 10: evidence that the Stripe-wide llms.txt specifically indexes the Radar pages, and independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs for Radar.
